findings.problem: The colloquial short form raus is just as right for this prompt and hint, and in everyday speech it is actually more common, so the hint does not lead to a single answer.
findings.fix: hint: out of somewhere, toward the speaker (the full form, not the short raus)

back.target: out (out of something, toward the speaker)
back.example: Come out of there at once!

note: In casual speech people would more likely say "Komm sofort da raus!", so the editor could mention raus as the spoken short form in the example or the trick.
